propositions: _pai_check_config currently raises loudly on any base_url or api_key, contradicting documented LMStudio/Ollama recipes and config parsing already present in the codebase

An openai builder must be registered in the provider factory to construct OpenAIChatModel with custom base_url, gated on cfg.base_url being set (not unconditionally, to preserve lazy resolution for bare openai:model strings)

The builder must override the provider's model_profile staticmethod to withdraw supports_json_schema_output=False, preventing silent wrong answers when an arbitrary OpenAI-compatible server does not implement strict json schema output faithfully

base_url is provider configuration not provider selection; REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER remains authoritative for choosing the provider, and base_url only triggers whether rebar constructs it or defers to pydantic-ai
pydantic-ai-slim[openai] must be added to the dev extra only, keeping the agents runtime extra lean and optional for end users while enabling CI tests to exercise the builder and end-to-end recipe
providers.py implementation must remain under the 300 LOC fixed capacity established by closed story S1
